BrochureContent.Content:
Keith McLoughlin of Sheehy Meares Auctioneers is delighted to present this beautifully restored two-storey farmhouse to the market, ideally located at Slevin, Tulsk, Co. Roscommon, between the villages of Tulsk and Castleplunket. Standing on approximately on a large site of mature, beautifully landscaped grounds, this charming home is presented in pristine, turnkey condition and offers the perfect blend of traditional character and modern comfort.
The property underwent a comprehensive renovation in 2020, with no expense spared. Works carried out included complete rewiring and replumbing, new windows and doors, a stylish fitted kitchen, contemporary bathrooms, drylining and insulation of all external walls, new flooring throughout, together with significant upgrades to the external outbuildings, including new timber and sheeting.
Flooded with natural light throughout, the accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a spacious utility room complete with laundry facilities and additional storage units, and a large open-plan kitchen/dining room featuring double-aspect windows, a fully fitted kitchen with ample storage, and tiled flooring. The bright sitting room also benefits from double-aspect windows, timber flooring, and a stylish open fireplace, creating a warm and inviting living space. A family bathroom completes the ground floor accommodation.
The first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms together with a modern family bathroom.
Externally, the property is surrounded by mature trees and enjoys a peaceful countryside setting . A range of well-maintained outbuildings provides excellent storage and offers potential for a variety of uses, subject to the necessary consents.
The property benefits from oil-fired central heating and is ideally located just 5 kilometres from Tulsk Village, offering easy access to shops, schools, restaurants, and everyday amenities. Roscommon Town is less than 25 minutes away, while Ireland West Airport Knock can be reached in approximately 40 minutes, making this an ideal location for those seeking peaceful country living without compromising on convenience.
This exceptional farmhouse has been finished to an outstanding standard throughout and represents a rare opportunity to acquire a beautifully renovated home in a tranquil yet highly accessible location. Early viewing is highly recommended.
